resources.string: One number a day, and a clear picture of where it is heading.
Account created for %1$s. Welcome to Scalable.
That username and password don\'t match. Check them and try again, or create an account if you\'re new.
The username %1$s is already taken. If it\'s yours, tap Sign in. Otherwise, choose a different username.
Choose a username with at least %1$d characters.
Choose a password with at least %1$d characters.
You reached your goal. Nice work.
You passed your goal by %1$s lb. Nice work.
Set a goal weight to see how far you have to go.
Add your first weigh-in to start tracking.
No weigh-ins yet. Tap Add weight to record today\'s weight.
The %1$s lb entry from %2$s will be removed from your history.
You already have %1$s lb recorded for %2$s. Do you want to replace it with %3$s lb?
That weigh-in couldn\'t be saved. Please try again.
You reached your goal of %1$s lb.
You reached your goal of %1$s lb. A text is on its way.
Pounds, up to one decimal place
Enter a weight between 50 and 700 lb
Scalable compares each new weigh-in against this number. It works the same whether you are working down to it, working up to it, or holding steady.
You are working down to this number, %1$s lb from your latest weigh-in.
You are working up to this number, %1$s lb from your latest weigh-in.
This matches your latest weigh-in, so Scalable will help you hold steady.
Type a goal to see which way you are heading.
Text me when I reach my goal
Scalable can send one text message to your phone on the day a weigh-in reaches your goal. Your weigh-ins never leave this phone, and that text is the only thing the app sends.
A 10-digit U.S. number, usually your own phone.
Enter a full 10-digit phone number, like (555) 123-4567.
Off. Scalable will not send any text messages. You will still see your goal message inside the app.
On. Scalable has permission to send texts and will send one when you reach your goal.
Almost on. Scalable has permission to send texts, but it needs a full 10-digit phone number first. Enter the number above and texts will turn on.
Permission denied. Scalable keeps working normally, but it will not send text messages. Your goal message will show inside the app instead.
SMS permission is turned off for Scalable in Android settings. To get texts, allow SMS for Scalable there and then turn this setting back on.
This device cannot send text messages, so SMS notifications are unavailable. Goal messages will show inside the app.
Scalable: You reached your goal weight of %1$s lb today. Nice work sticking with it.
Android will ask whether Scalable may send SMS messages. Scalable only uses this to text you when you reach your goal, and you can turn it off here at any time.
